criteria.silhouette_scale: Revised concept has dominant steel shoulders and narrow lengthwise slits within the same thick octagonal envelope. Its background vertical section retains excess glass; implementation applies the corrected shell to every orientation.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Solid 45-degree steel bevels and split cardinal plates frame real narrow glass apertures. No curved mesh needed.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Pipe reaches a square machine flange; elbow uses a compact connector. No moving hardware or floating support claimed.
criteria.period_materials: Steel and laboratory-style clear sight glass fit the nineteenth-century industrial family without ornamental brass.
criteria.family_consistency: Existing industrial steel remains the material authority; isolated glass glints are code-native optical details.
criteria.controls_readability: Empty scenery-visible tube contrasts clearly with amber flowing interior. No new controls.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Same transfer telemetry and routing; image's partly filled liquid is a visual suggestion, not a new stored-fluid mechanic. Native implementation uses a narrow internal stream.

criteria.matches_direction: Revised Blockbench view matches the steel-heavy concept: solid diagonal facets, thick cardinal shoulders and four 1.25-pixel slits. Glass occupies 18.9 percent of the perimeter before solid rings, with unchanged eight-pixel diameter.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Native 45-degree cuboids and two-sided thin glass planes, all within block bounds. Eight-pixel width and arms to block edge. Retained editable bbmodel and deterministic generation.
criteria.material_consistency: Steel sampled from the current shared steel plate center; no independently invented palette. Glass has ten deliberate pale glint pixels and otherwise zero alpha.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Multipart opposing arms join at center and block boundaries; compact eight-pixel junction only when axes differ. Flange remains wider than tube. Collision envelope updated for the new size.
criteria.animation_states: Idle renderer emits no fluid or opaque backing. Active octagonal internal stream stays inside glass and uses existing flow colors/time/direction.
criteria.native_size_readability: Static Blockbench preview retains recognizable octagon and open view. In-game closeups and inventory will check Photon and long runs.

criteria.photon_materials: Revised Photon captures show a dominant solid steel shell and small clear slits; patterned wall remains visible through aligned empty windows. Steel bevels read clearly at oblique angles.
criteria.scale_readability: Eight-pixel envelope is twice the previous width. Octagonal end rim and rings read in the oblique corner capture. Flush joints do not swell into repeating bulbs.
criteria.states_motion: Flow/motion captures show directional amber bands inside horizontal and vertical arms. Expiry assertion and empty capture verify that colored geometry vanishes after transfer events expire. Idle branch remains clear.
criteria.interaction_guides: Six-direction multipart connections fit around corners and meet the existing flange with no visible gap. No machine guide behavior changed. Larger selection/collision follows connected arms; existing server suite passed.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Creative hotbar shows the new hollow tube model; a naturally fine silhouette at inventory scale. Native editor views retain its octagonal section and transparent windows.
criteria.integration_limits: Steel-shell revision passed build/unit and focused Photon checks. Only native model geometry changed; server suite was not repeated. Previous routing, collision and transfer behavior retained. Other shader packs and moving vessels were not individually tested.
